sentences.ko: 우리 아까 창고에 있었는데, 진짜 소름 끼치는 남자를 하나 봤어.
sentences.text: We were We were just in the storage area and we saw this really creepy man.

alts.text: Just now in the storage room, we ran into this super creepy guy.
A moment ago we were in the storage area, and we saw a man who seemed rather disturbing.

sentences.note: **this really creepy man** 처럼, 처음 꺼내는 사람이나 물건 앞에 붙이는 this 는 '어떤 ~ 하나'라는 뜻입니다. 겪은 일을 이야기로 풀 때 자주 씁니다. 더 편하게는 **ran into** (우연히 마주쳤다) 를 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.text: So, I am just going to leave it entirely up to the gods of fate.

alts.text: Guess I'll just let fate decide.
It seems best to leave the matter entirely in the hands of fate.

sentences.note: **leave it entirely up to** 는 '결정을 아예 ~에게 넘기다'입니다. 사람한테도 쓰고(leave it up to you) 이렇게 운에도 씁니다. 더는 따지지 않고 손을 떼겠다는 뉘앙스입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 나 딱 하나만 빨리 처리하고 올게.
sentences.text: I just have to do one thing really quickly.

alts.text: Gotta take care of one quick thing.
There is just one matter I need to attend to briefly.

sentences.note: **do one thing really quickly** — 한국어는 '빨리 하나만'이라 순서가 반대인데, 영어는 '빨리'를 문장 끝에 둡니다. 잠깐 자리를 뜰 때 그대로 쓰는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 네 사이즈 아니까, 내가 진짜 괜찮은 걸로 골라 줄게.
sentences.text: I know your size and I'm going to I'm going to pick out some really good stuff for you.

alts.text: Leave it to me — I've got your size, and I'll grab some really nice things for you.
Since I am aware of your size, I will select some excellent items for you.

sentences.note: **pick out** 은 여럿 중에서 눈으로 고르는 것입니다(choose 보다 훨씬 입말). 옷이나 물건을 뭉뚱그릴 때는 **stuff** 하나면 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 나 어릴 때부터 발가락으로 동전 집을 수 있었어.
sentences.text: ever since I was little, I've been able to pick up quarters with my toes.

alts.text: I could pick up coins with my toes back when I was a kid, and I still can.
From a very young age, I have had the ability to pick up coins using my toes.

sentences.note: **ever since I was little** 는 '어릴 때부터 지금까지 쭉'이라 뒤에 현재완료(I've been able to)가 따라옵니다. 참고로 quarter 는 미국 25센트 동전입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아, 진짜 내가 이걸 고민하고 있다는 것 자체가 믿기지가 않네.
sentences.text: Oh god, I can't believe I'm even considering this.

alts.text: Wow, am I seriously thinking about this?
It is hard to believe that I am even considering this.

sentences.note: **I can't believe I'm even considering this**는 스스로도 말이 안 된다고 생각하면서 마음이 흔들릴 때 씁니다. **even**이 '이걸 생각하는 것 자체가'라는 뉘앙스를 만들어요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 이렇게 깔끔하게 헤어져 본 건 처음이야.
sentences.text: I have never had such a healthy breakup.

alts.text: That's the healthiest breakup I've ever had.
Never have I experienced such a healthy breakup.

sentences.note: 헤어지는 일에 **healthy**를 쓰면 서로 감정 상하지 않고 깔끔하게 정리했다는 뜻입니다. **such a**는 '이렇게까지 ~한'이라고 감탄할 때 붙입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 네 입에서 나오는 말 좀 걸러 주는 게 머릿속에 있었으면 좋겠다.
sentences.text: If only there was something in your head to control the things you say.

alts.text: Would be nice if you had a filter.
I wish you would think before you speak.

sentences.note: **If only**는 '~하기만 하면 좋을 텐데'라고 아쉬움을 담아 놀리듯 말할 때 씁니다. 생각 없이 말하는 사람에게는 **a filter**(거름망)가 없다고 해요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 남자들은 왜 자꾸 나한테 이런 식으로 말하지?
sentences.text: Why do men keep talking to me like this?

alts.text: What is it with guys talking to me like that?
I do not understand why men continue to speak to me in this manner.

sentences.note: **keep talking**처럼 keep + -ing 는 '자꾸 계속 그런다'며 짜증이 묻어날 때 씁니다. **like this**는 말투가 무례하거나 사람을 깔본다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 이 얘기는 여기서 그만하고 다 같이 밥이나 맛있게 먹자.
sentences.text: Let's move past this and try to have a nice meal all together.

alts.text: Can we drop it and just enjoy dinner?
I suggest we put this behind us and enjoy our meal together.

sentences.note: **move past this**는 다툰 일을 더 파고들지 말고 넘어가자는 말입니다. 격식 있게 말할 때는 **put this behind us**를 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends
